response.sql:
WITH overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS overall_avg_rebate
  FROM fees
), grouped AS (
  SELECT
    f.orderslink,
    o.ordertune,
    AVG(f.rebtotal) AS avg_rebate,
    AVG((f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0)) AS avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.ordertune
)
SELECT
  g.orderslink,
  g.ordertune,
  g.avg_rebate,
  g.avg_relative_gap,
  g.avg_rebate - overall.overall_avg_rebate AS margin_above_overall_avg
FROM grouped AS g
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE g.avg_rebate > overall.overall_avg_rebate
ORDER BY margin_above_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The overall average rebate is across all fee records, including fees without a matching order; the requested combinations themselves exclude fees without a matching order.

alternatives.interpretation: If the overall average should use only fees linked to a matching order, calculate it over the same inner join.
